oneclick.title: One-click install
oneclick.lead: Install everything at once with sensible defaults. You can also install components individually on the Components tab.
oneclick.skipHint: Components already installed and satisfying requirements are skipped (toggle above to force reinstall).

components.title: Components
components.lead: Each component can be installed or reinstalled on its own - for example, to switch to a different Python version.

uv.title: uv package manager
uv.hint: An extremely fast Python package and version manager; Python is installed and managed through it.

python.title: Python
python.hint: Choose the Python version to install; downloaded and managed by uv.
python.setDefault: Also create the python / python3 commands

vscode.title: Visual Studio Code
vscode.hint: Install the latest stable VSCode with the extensions needed for Python development.
vscode.enable: Install VSCode (turn off for terminal-only setups)

network.title: Network
network.lead: If you are behind a firewall or proxy, configure it here. Leave empty for a direct connection.
network.hint: If some endpoints are unreachable, set a proxy above and test again.

path.title: PATH environment
path.lead: So that the uv, Python and code commands are found, these directories need to be on your PATH.
path.windowsNote: On Windows the current user's PATH (registry) is updated - no administrator rights required.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lead: Interface language and configuration. Settings are saved to a local config file used by the CLI and the next launch.
settings.configNote: The same config file can be used by the pydev-cli command-line tool.

log.title: Activity log
log.empty: No output yet. Progress will stream here once an install starts.
